text_block_list.text:
While walking through the shopping 
district with Mejiro Dober—
(Clang-clang!)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...A raffle, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer. Wanna give it a shot just 
once?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Why not? I didn't get to draw a fortune 
for New Year's anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. It just hit me that I hadn't 
drawn a New Year's fortune yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just thought it'd be nice to test our 
luck for the both of us here. ...So, what 
do you say?
choice_data_list: Let's take on the challenge together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just thought it'd be nice to test our 
luck for the both of us here. ...So, what 
do you say?
choice_data_list: Let's take on the challenge together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Well then, let's go get our 
lottery tickets right away. Um, we get 
them if we buy something, right?

And so, I finished shopping with Mejiro 
Dober to get the raffle tickets. And 
then...

Together with Mejiro Dober, I spun the 
raffle wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: T-The grand prize...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... I never thought testing my 
luck would turn out like this...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: That really is mega-great fortune~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, maybe so! Way more than great luck――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Fukukitaru!?
choice_data_list: You're Mejiro Dober's friend, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Happy New Year! It's 
Matikanefukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I was at that bookstore when I overheard 
the words "test of luck"! So I couldn't 
help but think it was my time to shine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Still, the grand prize! What marvelous, 
supreme luck! That fortune says the future 
is bright for both Dober-san and her 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: U-Um... thank you...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And while we're at it, may I also divine 
the best time and partner for you, Miss 
Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...What?!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, since we have the chance, I'd like 
to hear it.
Yeah, since I'm here, I might as well ask.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...It's out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fast...ugh?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My recommendation is whenever both people 
have calmed down! And of course, the best 
match is always the two people closest to 
each other!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And so, bye-byyyye!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list:
Well, it's just fortune-telling, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that was kind of a lukewarm 
result.
choice_data_list:
Well, it's just fortune-telling, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Because you went and tried to push 
things forward on your own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Then when the time 
comes... If either of us wants to use it 
with someone else, we'll just hand the 
ticket over to the other.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll hold onto it for now until things 
settle down. See you later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"If there ever comes a time you want to 
use it together... Could we just leave it 
for then?"

And so, for the time being, the hot spring 
trip voucher was left in Mejiro Dober's 
care.

And so, for the time being, the hot spring 
trip voucher was left in Mejiro Dober's 
care.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No way, first prize...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. You're getting way too 
excited...! I mean, I'm the one who 
brought it up, but still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. We might be off to a 
great start!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you two get along so well! Since 
you're here, let me throw in a little 
bonus!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you two get along so well! Since 
you're here, let me throw in a little 
bonus!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh!? G-Good friends? No way, that's...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, please... A bonus is really too 
much...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Here, two pieces of candy! I can't throw 
in an extra Hamburg steak, of course, so 
split it between the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Here, two pieces of candy! I can't throw 
in an extra Hamburg steak, of course, so 
split it between the two of you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wah...!? Th-Thank you very much...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Uh... Um. Trainer, about that prize 
earlier...
choice_data_list:
Which flavor of candy do you prefer, 
Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, candy? Candy is... Between mandarin 
orange and strawberry... strawberry, I 
guess.
choice_data_list:
Got it, I'll give it to you later with the 
hamburger steak

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yeah. ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...Right. Of course! There's no way 
Trainer would ever invite me to split food 
in half or eat a hamburg steak 
together...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Come on, this isn't a manga...! What am I 
even thinking...?!)

For some reason, Mejiro Dober left the 
shopping street while lightly smacking 
herself on the head.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yay...! Hehe, I guess this counts as 
moderate luck...?
choice_data_list: That's a great result, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah... That's true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I hope things just keep looking 
up from here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Still, I'm glad we got to pull 
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Still, I'm glad we got to pull 
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Both for you and for me, Trainer. The 
path the two of us walk from now on will 
always be the same, so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hold on. Strike that. I feel like I just 
said something embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...That's how it is. So just forget it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...If it didn't bother you, then that's 
fine."

Illuminated by the setting sun on our way 
home, Mejiro Dober's cheeks were tinged 
with a faint blush.

Illuminated by the setting sun on our way 
home, Mejiro Dober's cheeks were tinged 
with a faint blush.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...If it's my fortune, I got "Small 
Blessing." Fufu...
choice_data_list: You look surprisingly happy about this.

You look surprisingly happy about this, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Is that bad?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Because honestly, I thought it suited 
the current me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I mean, this result shows there's still 
higher ground... and that we can aim for 
it, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I mean, this result shows there's still 
higher ground... and that we can aim for 
it, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. That's why we have to do our 
best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. That's why we have to do our 
best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...From here. From now on—

Mejiro Dober smiled as she gazed at the 
prize carrot.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...A dud, huh...
choice_data_list:
Don't worry about it! Want to try drawing 
again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ......Sorry.
choice_data_list:
Don't worry about it! Want to try drawing 
again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'll pass. Fortune slips are only meant 
to be drawn once anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'll pass. Fortune slips are only meant 
to be drawn once anyway, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I was determined to give it my all no 
matter what, but... still..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
......Um, sorry. I shouldn't have stuck my 
nose in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. I ended up making you worry 
about me too, Trainer. I'm so sorry.

Reassuring a disheartened Mejiro Dober 
that I didn't mind at all, we headed back 
to the academy.
